bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
echo "BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)"
echo "HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "BOT_RUNNING=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
echo "USERBOT_SERVICE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)"
echo "LIVE_SHA=$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)"
echo "START_DEEP_LINK_SOURCE_MATCHES:"
rg -n --glob '*.{ts,tsx,mjs,js,py}' --glob '!**/node_modules/**' 'start=|startapp=|\\/start|start_param|startless|t.me/GayBBS_bot' artifacts/bot/src scripts | head -120 | sed -E 's/(token|password|secret)=([^ ,]+)/\1=REDACTED/Ig' || true
echo "STARTLESS_TEST_PATHS:"
find artifacts/bot/tests scripts -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*startless*' -o -iname '*topic*audit*' \) | head -40
